_comment: The film's vehicles (Oct 20 2026). Models: tools/house/purchased_vehicles.py -> unity/HomeAlone/Assets/Purchased/Vehicles/<kind>.glb (CC-BY Sketchfab downloads, gitignored, CREDITS.md). Prefabs: Editor/VehiclePrefabs.Build() -> Assets/Purchased/Vehicles/<kind>.prefab (root at the ground contact, nose +z, metres), which the neighbourhood's swap hook instances in place of the nb_life proxy of the same kind. Positions are NOT here: tools/house/nb_life.py layout() (life_layout.json items) owns them, each with its film evidence; checked against these models below.

Car_CapricePolice.film: 11574-11636 (night): two 1987-90 Chevrolet Caprice cruisers at the Murphys', navy with a light belt band, POLICE on the front fender band, the Winnetka shield on the front doors, a chrome bar of two MARS beacons + two round flashers + a siren speaker, all red

police_lights.maths: Against film 11581 under our exterior night look (auto exposure, bloom 0.8 / threshold 0.3, volumetric fog on). (1) Lamp glass: the street lamp globe (NB_LampGlobe, 4000 nits, ~0.3 m) reads as a bright point with a small halo in build 8's van-night; the film's beacons are smaller points of the same class: a near-white core with a red rim. A red lamp (1, 0.05, 0.02) whitens only where its weak green and blue channels also clip, ~20x the level where its red clips, so the peak sits a little under the globe: 1500 nits (flashers 1100). Between sweeps the glass glows dull red: idle 0.04 (60 nits, about the bloom threshold, no halo). Build 8 had 6000/4000 nits, idle 0.06. (2) Wash: the film's snow wash is subtle, weaker than a street-lamp pool. Lamp: 2400 lm at 3.85 m = 191 cd, 12.9 lx at its foot. Wash: 300 lm at the bar (1.8 m) = 24 cd, 7.4 lx straight below, 2.2 lx at 2 m out, 0.2 lx at 6 m; with the sweep (floor 0.2) the mean is ~0.6 of that: a red/blue pool around the car about a third of a lamp pool, gone by the Murphys' porch (7 m range). Build 8 had 2500 lm, 14 m. (3) No volumetric contribution: build 8's magenta and cyan balls were the fog in-scattering (anisotropy 0.6 toward the camera) of two 2500 lm lights. Specular kept: 11581 shows red streaks on the wet road.

materials._note: HDRP Lit per VEH_* glTF material (VehiclePrefabs.Hdrp). The base colour map comes from the GLB. coat > 0 = HDRP Lit clear coat (the Unity 6 HDRP way for car paint at game cost; StackLit's dual-lobe coat is ~2x the shading cost). mask: R metallic, G AO, A smoothness (grime rougher), linear. emissive_nits: _EmissiveColor in nits (the house's lamp globes are 4000). Every vehicle renderer also gets SpecGreybox.LayerOutside so the moon lights it (build 8: black silhouettes).

VEH_Van_Paint.note: dull weathered clear coat; grime in the albedo and the mask
